items.markdown:
`The UK bridging loan market reached a record outstanding loan book of £13.4 billion` . Monthly interest rates typically start from around 0.59% to 0.81%, with average loan-to-value (LTV) ratios hovering near 52% to 55% and typical completion timeframes taking between 4 and 6 weeks.[](https://bridgingloandirectory.co.uk/guides/uk-bridging-market-trends-2025-lower-rates-rising-applications-what-it-means-for-you/) [[1]](https://bridgingloandirectory.co.uk/guides/uk-bridging-market-trends-2025-lower-rates-rising-applications-what-it-means-for-you/)[[2]](https://bridgingfinance4u.co.uk/bridging-finance-uk-guide/)[[3]](https://www.cliftonpf.co.uk/blog/27062025164949-bridging-loan-statistics/)Market Size and Growth

- **Outstanding Loan Book:** Surpassed £13.4 billion by late 2025, up from £10 billion in 2024.
- **Application Volumes:** Hit multi-billion-pound highs, reflecting heavy demand from property professionals.
- **Sector Shift:** Permanently transitioned from a niche alternative to mainstream property finance.[](https://bridgingfinance4u.co.uk/bridging-finance-uk-guide/) [[1]](https://thebdla.org/news/bridging-market-maintains-momentum-in-2025/)

Rates and Financial Metrics

- **Average Monthly Rates:** Range between 0.59% and 0.88% per month, depending on risk and lender.
- **Average LTV:** Generally sits around 52.8%, though maximum caps reach up to 75% or 80%.
- **Arrangement Fees:** Standardly set at approximately 2% of the gross loan amount.[](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/blog/bridging-loan-book-forecast-to-hit-12bn-in-2025) [[1]](https://www.westoneloans.co.uk/blog/bridging-loan-book-forecast-to-hit-12bn-in-2025)[[2]](https://bridgingloandirectory.co.uk/bridging-finance/bridging-trends-in-the-uk-resilient-market-and-improved-efficiency/)[[3]](https://www.moneysupermarket.com/loans/bridge-loans/)

Usage and Completion Times

- **Primary Uses:** Investment purchases (such as buy-to-let portfolios), auction purchases, and breaking property chains.
- **Completion Speed:** Averages 43 days, with streamlined applications completing in as few as 5 to 10 working days.
- **Regulation Split:** Regulated loans (primary residences) make up roughly 46% to 58% of transactions, with the remainder going to unregulated business and investment uses.[](https://bridgingfinance4u.co.uk/bridging-finance-uk-guide/) [[1]](https://www.acquisition-international.com/uk-bridging-loan-market-set-for-further-growth/)[[2]](https://www.fundingagent.co.uk/post/bridging-finance-statistics-uk)

If you are looking into short-term finance, let me know:

- Are you planning a **regulated or unregulated** purchase?
- What is your planned **exit strategy** (sale or refinance)?

I can help explain the costs or criteria that apply to your scenario.
